problems.title: One slot, overwrite by default
problems.detail: say() keeps one line for 3.2 s and every call replaces it. About 205 raid call sites; only 21 use sayWhenFree. Danger alerts (Crier 19764/19809, Pillbox 19646, boss 19673, DOWN 14517, clock 32834/32842, woke 9469) are lost to the zone, loot or confirm line that follows within 3.2 s.

problems.title: Same-frame clobbers wipe lines before any frame draws them
problems.detail: CONTRACT DONE (3671) is overwritten by the Warden, Pillbox and Listener kill lines (contractKill at 19129 runs first) and by 'Found:' (contractOpen runs before grantLoot). The boss line 19158 is overwritten by 19159. Each emote line 8499 is overwritten by its result line. 'Found: X' is overwritten by 'Took X.' on every staged pull. The DOWN line is overwritten by 16212 when you are knocked down mid-pull.

problems.title: No width limit or wrap
problems.detail: The line is one fillText call with a plate sized to the text. Story text 24754 (200-310 chars), the stall sale 10085 (~135), the call line 16363 (~135), stray 10002 (~115) and the storm weather line (~113) run off both screen edges, and more so at 4K with hudZoom.

problems.title: Keyboard key names shown to the pad player
problems.detail: Player 2 is on a controller, yet raid lines hard-code 'Hold E' (16212, 16363, 16862, 16892, outHint 32837), 'Z drops' (17917), 'CAPS' (17176-17177), 'Press T or Y' (40384) and 'F9' (33565). Only 14517, 41797 and gunKeyLine go through keyLabel or padB.

problems.title: No severity styling
problems.detail: Danger, loot, confirmations and debug text share one colour, one font role (TYPE.label, the same role as world labels) and one plate. The only emphasis is ad hoc ALL CAPS (DOWN., CONTRACT DONE:, EXTRACTION IS OPEN., THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU., MOVE., THE SIEGE:).

problems.title: Queue has no priority, expiry or limit
problems.detail: G.msgQ is FIFO, so 'teammate is down' (38728) and 'Extraction closes' (16939) wait behind lower lines and can show stale. Per-frame say() (17917 while E is held, 16287 every 2.5 s, 42063) keeps refreshing msgT and starves the queue.

problems.title: Line freezes while paused, in the death beat and during the burn
problems.detail: msgT ticks only in the running branch (33949). Lines said from the pause box or Settings (Cursor reset, HUD size, Superhot, Raid clock changed, controller disconnected, backups) sit unseen under the box and play after resume. The last line hangs at full alpha through the death beat and the burn.

problems.title: Lines that are never seen
problems.detail: 16217 is said, then endRaid runs in the same frame. 43005 is covered by the outcome card (the code comment admits it). The jam lines 17386/17497 cannot fire because no weapon has jam>0 (his ruling: guns never jam).

problems.title: Duplicates other channels
problems.detail: The extraction banner (EXTRACT L INBOUND / EXTRACT IN PROGRESS!) vs 16287/16862/41134, with different words for the same state. The MARKED banner vs 19764/19809; the banner says THEY KNOW WHERE YOU ARE even on the last-seen branch. The downed overlay '[F] SELF-REVIVE' vs 14517. NOTORIETY +1 label plus notoStamp vs 9868/19090/19113. World loot labels vs Found:/Took. REVIVED/PICKED UP labels vs the revive lines. NO AMMO/RELOADING HUD vs 17524/17378. The gift line vs 40384.

problems.title: Map-wide chatter takes the line
problems.detail: Events with no distance gate print wherever you are: 20711 pillager extracted, 20651 called extraction, 19334 survivor out, 19412/19404 Peddler, 19096/19118 deaths, 16641 wave. Zone crossings (34026, 6 s cooldown) and landmark entries (34013, no cooldown) fire often. All of these can overwrite danger lines.

problems.title: Debug text on the player line
problems.detail: 25749 prints a raw render error, 33762 prints a raw JS message, 17826 'Wall glitch logged', and two different perf lines (22700, 33807). F9 recorder lines (33565-33581) also go to the raid line.

problems.title: Punctuation and casing are inconsistent
problems.detail: No period: Waypoint marked/cleared, Zoom N%, HUD size N%, Reloaded, Patched up, Already at full, No medical supplies, No throwables, X ready, X up, Item to slot N, Found:. Ellipsis on Applying/Slotting/Reloading..., while 17378 says Reloading. Colon labels (Order:, Found:, Raid clock changed:, Running slowly:). Double spaces at 16065 and 32836. A spaced hyphen at 10085.

problems.title: Vocabulary breaks
problems.detail: 'belt' alone (12336, 14844, 15779) where the word is Tactical belt. The belt cell is called slot, key, cell, belt slot and weapon slot. 'way out' and 'point' for extraction (outHint, 16278). 'called extraction' (20651, 41134) where the rule is call FOR. 'map' as a place in weather lines. 'kit' (15621). 'armoury' (15733). 'Walked out' where the verb is Abandon. 'slab' for the Bulwark. 'crier' lowercase. Waypoint vs Marker.

problems.title: Name casing
problems.detail: toLowerCase() on item names (9979, 19355, 17721) and on place names through placeName() (34013, 34026). Lowercase 'your teammate' fallback starts sentences in netAidFinish (40137). ALL CAPS 'PILLAGER' fallback at 41789. 'stim', 'plate' and 'bandages' are lowercase.

problems.title: TX and baked edits
problems.detail: Every G.msg passes through TX() in the patched fillText. No raid line is a TXSHIP key, so none is protected, and most lines are built by concatenation, so his in-game edits can only match the fixed lines.

problems.title: say() called from a draw function
problems.detail: drawGiftLine writes the offer-expired lines from the render path.

problems.title: Skipped as Undercroft or menu only
problems.detail: 15 say() calls: Mainframe racks and arrays 34137, 34142, 34157, 34158, 34173; import a friend 34222, 34230, 34234; core slot 34284, 34286, 34298; Settings backup and restore 44498, 44649, 44664, 44680 (reachable from the raid pause box, where they land frozen on the raid line). Also hub-only: about 90 say2 calls, 8 netSay calls (lines outside the hub are dropped silently), and 6 direct hubToast calls.

problems.title: No shared text style: 12 plate variants and most world text has none
problems.detail: Plates are plain fillRect at alpha .62 (message), .72 (boss, cook, search count, reload bar), .78 (zone badge, gift, cook shout) or .82 with a red border (notoriety), plus rounded hudPanel (conditions .76, use bar .78) and status pills .62. Padding is 4, 6, 8, 12, LH(6), LH(8) or LH(18). Door, revive, container, ring prompts, clock, compass, MARKED, ? and !, reticle words and REVIVING have no plate, shadow or outline. strokeText is never used; YOU DIED is the only text with a drop shadow. Bare text on bright ground is hard to read on a TV.

problems.title: Prompts of the same kind use different sizes
problems.detail: [E] SEARCH is TYPE.head (23.4px at 1080p, v10.52), while UNLOCK, REVIVE, EXTRACT, CALL FOR EXTRACTION and INBOUND are TYPE.label (18.7px). Second lines differ too: the container item name inherits head, the door 'needs the' line is micro. ? and ! use head. The CONDITIONS title is the same micro size as its rows.

problems.title: Extraction state worded three or four ways at once
problems.detail: Standing in an inbound ring shows the badge 'EXTRACTION POINT - 12S UNTIL EXTRACTION BEGINS' and the prompt 'INBOUND 12s'; other rings say 'EXTRACT A INBOUND 12s'; holding says 'EXTRACT IN PROGRESS!  A  12S LEFT' or '[E] EXTRACT - 12s'. The badge says SOUND THE ALARM while the prompt says CALL FOR EXTRACTION, and the compass switches between EXTRACT and EXTRACTION. Seconds are 'S' in the badge and extractNowLine and 's' everywhere else. The badge and extractNowLine words are his (v11.54, v17.95), so rewording them needs his OK.

problems.title: Some raid text keeps its 1080p size at 4K
problems.detail: The reticle state words (JAMMED, NO AMMO, EMPTY - R) and the reload seconds use FS(TYPE.micro) with raw offsets. The ammo and reload ring line widths (3.4, 2.2, 4.4, 2.4) do not scale, though the cross does. The ? and ! markers, the gift offer line's font and plate (only its y scales) and the use-bar caption (its bar scales) are unscaled too. All of these come out about half their intended size on his 4K TVs.

problems.title: Hard-coded key names skip keyLabel
problems.detail: 'EMPTY - R' always says R, but on the pad reload is X (pollPad: X with nothing near holds KeyR), and a rebound keyboard key is ignored. The offer line says 'T or Y', so both players see both keys, and rebinding T is ignored. The door, revive, search and ring prompts do go through keyLabel.

problems.title: The message line has one slot and overwrites
problems.detail: say() sets G.msg with msgT 3.2 s. A second call replaces the line at once, and only sayWhenFree queues. The line is full for 2.2 s, then fades for 1 s. It has no priority, no category colour and no stacking. Trade expiry, pickups, kills and warnings all compete for it. The plate is a plain rectangle, not the rounded hudPanel.

problems.title: Plates are sized from the untranslated string
problems.detail: The prototype fillText wrapper (2773) draws TX(text), but every plate is measured with measureText on the original string before that swap. His own rewordings (P.txt, TXSHIP) therefore get a plate of the wrong width. This affects the message line, zone badge, notoriety stamp, gift line, cook shout and search count.

problems.title: Casing and separators are mixed
problems.detail: ALL CAPS prompts sit beside sentence-case lines (gift line, notoriety body) and lowercase ones ('1 item left', 'needs the X', 'no heals yet', 'sight -20%'). The weather row mixes 'noon'/'DAWN' with 'Storming'/'TURNING'. Separators vary between ' - ', ' · ', '!', double spaces and triple spaces. Counts appear as 'n/m' and as 'n of m'. The revive name is not uppercased, though the search corpse name is.

problems.title: Text can overlap and only two prompts dodge
problems.detail: Only the zone badge and the door prompt call hudDodge, and that is only against the corner box. The container, door, revive and in-ring prompts do not avoid each other. At 1080p, with the boss bar up, the gift plate (about y 224-258) overlaps the notoriety plate (about y 247-325). The ? and ! markers sit over the world-pass nameplates.

problems.title: The CONDITIONS panel is hard to read
problems.detail: The rows are 15.6px text on a 17px line (LH(11)), so they are tightly packed. The title has the same size as the rows. Conduct verdicts print as 'LOST   BROKEN, you healed', which says the same thing twice. Drinks are listed both here and in the status icon column.

problems.title: Too many near-identical colours
problems.detail: The reds are #ff5a4a, #ff5040, rgba(255,60,40), #ff6b5a, #ff8a76, rgba(224,72,58), #c0503a and #ff4a3a. The whites are #cdd6dd, rgba(232,240,246), #e8f0f6 and rgba(230,240,246). Amber #ffc04a stands for both a prompt and a warning. There is no semantic token set for danger, ally, loot or extract.

problems.title: Dead code and unreachable text
problems.detail: fillStyle is set and then overwritten at 27817 and at 28080. JAMMED needs p.jam>0, but every weapon has jam:0 (his no-jam ruling).

problems.title: Cook shout is effectively always on
problems.detail: cookShout fires when the fuse has 1.0s or less left, but FRAG_FUSE is 1.1, so 'COOKED GRENADE! THROW GRENADE NOW' starts flashing 0.1s into every frag cook and covers about 91% of it. The countdown under it turns amber at 0.36s and red at 0.73s, so the 'last second' warning no longer marks a moment.

problems.title: No single text style: 9 plate variants, 5 ways of scaling
problems.detail: Plates: flat .72 / .78 / .62 / .55 / .90 / .97 rects, hudPanel at .62 / .76 / .78 / .84, a red-stroked notoriety box, and no plate at all. Scaling: hudFS, hudAtIn, ctx.scale(hudRes), hudZoomIn corner zooms, or none. Only YOU DIED has a shadow, and nothing has an outline. The bare-text lines include the extraction band headline and row, the seal, stray and alert prompts, REVIVING, crier, pings and arrows, which are the lines that matter most over a bright street on a TV.

problems.title: Many raid lines stay 1080p size at 4K
problems.detail: Not grown with hudRes: wind-up bar text (its bar doubles), offer line text and plate (only its y moves), seal prompt and bar, stray GIVE prompt, ?/! alert markers, emote strip, crier labels, pings, map markers, teammate edge arrow, and notes logged. At 4K these come out half the size of the message line, boss name and extraction band beside them.

problems.title: One fact shown in three or four places
problems.detail: Extraction landed and standing in the ring: the band says 'EXTRACT IN PROGRESS!  A  8S LEFT', the centre says 'HOLD E TO EXTRACT', and other rings show extractNowLine plus say() lines. Healing: the posture chip says HEALING, so does the status icon, the wind-up bar says APPLYING BANDAGE, and the green block shows on the bar. Winded: the stamina word, the status icon and the bar colour. Crouched: the posture chip says CROUCHED and the hidden chip says '... · CROUCHED'. Wading: the posture chip and the status icon.

problems.title: Hardcoded or mixed key names
problems.detail: 'HOLD E TO CUT THE SEAL' hardcodes E: wrong on a pad (X) and after a key remap. The offer line hardcodes T and shows 'T or Y' whatever device is in use. The gun card cue hardcodes 'B / I'. Bracket style varies inside the same downed stack: 'HOLD X TO EXTRACT' vs 'HOLD [A] TO SURRENDER' vs '[D-DOWN] SELF-REVIVE'.

problems.title: Units, spacing and separators disagree
problems.detail: Seconds are written '12s', '12S LEFT', '12S UNTIL', '0:12', '1.2s' and '2.3s' (toFixed vs ceil). Distance is '123m' in the band and downed lines but '123M' in pings, markers and arrows. The ring label 'EXTRACT A INBOUND 12s' has one space where the band copy has two. Separators include '  ·  ', '   ·   ', ' + ', ' - ', '!' and ':'.

problems.title: Casing has no rule
problems.detail: CAPS headlines sit next to sentence-case lines ('Bleeding out. Crawl to an open extraction point.', the offer line, '{n} converging on the ring', '{n} items left') and all-lowercase hints ('weapon down, they will listen', 'controls [+]', 'banked'). Some lines mix both: '[F] SELF-REVIVE, one per raid', 'CONTROLLER PAUSED: click one of the game windows', 'YOU killed CRAWLER'.

problems.title: Emote strip covers the belt at 1440p and 4K
problems.detail: The emote strip sits at a fixed H-LH(112) (H-175 at uiScale 1.2), but the belt top is H-bw-LH(13) and grows to bw=LH(112) at 4K (top H-195), or bw about 139 at 1440p (top 1281 vs the strip at 1265-1312). The strip's .90 tiles are drawn after the belt, over the top of the slots. At 1080p it covers the belt caption.

problems.title: Plates measured on the original words, text drawn reworded
problems.detail: proto.fillText runs every string through TX() (2773), but measureText is not wrapped. Every measured plate (offer line, wind-up bar, hidden chip, notoriety, centre verb, search count, kill feed, controller paused) is sized for the original string while his P.txt rewording is drawn, so an edited line overflows or floats in its plate. None of this slice's strings are TXSHIP keys (checked 2682).

problems.title: Amber means everything
problems.detail: #ffc04a is used for the boss name, offer line, controller paused, backpack cue, inbound headline, distance arrow, seal prompt, search count, reload and RELOADING, '?' marker, legend headings, the raider board header and own kill feed lines. Danger, ally, tutorial and objective have no separate colours.

problems.title: Top-centre stack can hit the notoriety stamp
problems.detail: The boss bar, offer and controller plates stack down from the message plate in LH units (at 1080p boss 183-218, offer 224-258, controller 264-291). The notoriety plate is fixed at H*0.26 (247-325), so with the boss bar and an offer up they overlap, and more so at a larger text setting.

problems.title: Liquor/Blotter warp every HUD word
problems.detail: drawBuzzFx runs after drawHUD and applies buzzWarp to the HUD canvas at about half strength (drift, tinted copies), with overlay colour washes on top. Prompts, timers and the downed overlay double and sway, where AAA games keep the HUD stable.

problems.title: Wind-up bar drawn first, so later layers paint over it
problems.detail: drawUseBar is called at the top of drawHUD, before the belt, vitals, extraction band, stray/seal prompts and emote strip. It avoids the band and emote strip by moving, but anything else drawn there covers it.

problems.title: Noise and dead branches in the HUD
problems.detail: Posture chip shows STANDING all the time. 'N notes logged' is debug-style text in a raid with no font set (micro leaks in from netMateArrow and netPingDraw in co-op). Dead code: the TERMS badge, wear name, throwable labels pl2, centre verb _sub, and JAMMED (guns never jam per his ruling).

problems.title: Vocabulary clash on 'down'
problems.detail: The raider board's '{n} out · {n} down' counts dead pillagers, while DOWN elsewhere (downed overlay, teammate rows, arrow) means downed and revivable. The extraction badge says 'SOUND THE ALARM' while the band prompt says 'CALL FOR EXTRACTION'.

problems.title: Small sizing faults
problems.detail: ARMOUR label text (18.7px) sits inside a 16-unit bar, the same spill v18.40 fixed for stamina. The cook countdown uses micro type on a fixed 116-wide plate. The boss bar is 6 units tall with no HP number. The posture chip colours the whole compound line by its first part, and JOGGING and SWITCHING GUNS have no STATCOL entry.

problems.title: Two-player notes
problems.detail: Each window draws its own HUD from its own G and profile: boss barSeen, status column, wind-up, downed overlay. Co-op-only channels are teammate rows, edge arrow, kill feed, pings and markers, and the offer line. Controller paused is NET.same only. P2 on a pad gets keyLabel and padB names except in the hardcoded strings above.

problems.title: A downed teammate has nothing over him in the world
problems.detail: Pillagers get '[E] REVIVE NAME 12s'. A downed teammate only keeps his gold name tag (netUpTags): no DOWN word, no bleed timer, no revive prompt. REVIVING only appears after E is already held. His state is shown only in the left HUD row and the edge arrow when he is off screen. For a co-op game this is the most important prompt missing.

problems.title: Screen-pixel lifts put world prompts and markers in the wrong place at 4K
problems.detail: w2s(x,h,y) subtracts h AFTER the zoom, so every lift (26, 30, 34, 40, 66, r+18, spriteTop+22) stays 1080p-sized while the world doubles. At 4K the ? and ! land under the world-scaled nameplate, on the body. The ring badge sits inside the ring's top half. The crier ring drifts off the sprite. Container prompts sink onto the crate. The same happens with user zoom and ADS zoom. hudAtIn scales the text but not the anchor.

problems.title: Several world-anchored channels do not grow at 4K
problems.detail: These are drawn on the HUD canvas in FS or fixed pixels, with no hudAtIn or hudFS: the ? and ! markers (FS head), the stray GIVE and seal prompts (and the 140x7 seal bar), CRIER n.ns and its ring and chevron, the noise chevrons (6-11.5 px, 26 px pad), and co-op pings, markers and teammate arrows (FS micro). Prompts beside them that use hudAtIn double in size.

problems.title: An alarmed Crier stacks four texts in about 30 px
problems.detail: At 1080p: the world ALARM (baseline about 49 u up, drawn in the sprite pass), then the nameplate plate and 'CRIER E-42' drawn over it (plate about 39-61 u), the HUD 'CRIER 3.2s' (about 60 u) and the '!' marker (about 56 u, 23 px head font) printed on top of the CRIER text. It reads as one smear at exactly the moment it matters.

problems.title: WEAK SPOT is pushed per round and evicts loot names
problems.detail: label('WEAK SPOT') fires for every weak hit, with no throttle, so one shotgun blast makes up to 8 labels stacked into a column. G.labels caps at 40 with shift(), which drops the OLDEST entries first: the 6 s item names from the crate you just opened. Each weak hit also adds an orange damage number, a hit mark, a spark and a clank.

problems.title: World feedback text is drawn under the darkness and fog sheets
problems.detail: Labels, damage numbers, nameplates, party tags, emote bubbles, cache tags and ALARM are all drawn inside the world pass, before litC (night: 0.30 indigo outside lamp pools) and fogC (night 0.60, day 0.46 outside the cone). Rain hairlines and fog haze are drawn on top of them as well. Loot names rising behind you when you turn away, or a kill at the edge of sight, come out dimmed to roughly 30-55 percent. Only the strike label and the noise and ping rings are drawn after the fog.

problems.title: Taunt shouts never appear as words
problems.detail: taunt() passes the sentence (for example 'Contact, right there!') as the glyph to emoteBubble. The bubble renderer only knows wave, palm, point, nod and no, and draws a think mark for anything else. The 18 TAUNT lines have never been on screen. The 'hurt' pool is also never called. The taunt bubble also sits at y-64 while others sit at y-34.

problems.title: Label plates and row spacing are smaller than the font
problems.detail: The renderer draws a fixed 13 u plate (-10..+3) under text that is 15.6 u (micro) or 18.7 u (big). Big labels' capitals stick out about 3 u above the plate, and descenders hang below it. LBL_STEP 15 is less than 18.7, so stacked big loot names overlap. The Undercroft station plates were fixed for this same fault at v18.63 using actualBoundingBoxAscent; raid labels were not. label() also measures a LH(26) icon allowance while the renderer uses 15.

problems.title: No single style for in-world prompts
problems.detail: SEARCH uses the head font; door, revive and ring prompts use the label font; cook uses micro; the Peddler deal sits inside his micro nameplate. Only the search count, cook and badge have plates. The rest are bare text in eight colours. Two grammars are in use: '[E] VERB' and 'HOLD E TO ...'. Separators vary (' - ', '  ', ': ', '  ·  '). There is no key-glyph plate, no hold ring and no fade in or out.

problems.title: The same fact is printed two or three times
problems.detail: A live ring shows the badge ('{n}S UNTIL EXTRACTION BEGINS') plus 'EXTRACT A INBOUND 12s', and the pad also shows 'INBOUND 12s'. A stray's need appears on the nameplate, as a NEEDS: label, in say() and in the GIVE prompt. Notoriety appears in say(), as a +1 label and on the stamp. SEAL BROKEN is on the slab and in a label. The boss name is on the top bar and on his nameplate. A fleeing pillager gets IS RUNNING and [RUNNING].

problems.title: Vocabulary breaks in world text
problems.detail: A destroyed machine reads 'NAME DOWN' and the board says 'N down' for the dead, while DOWNED means revivable (v8.79 split these for pillagers). The container prompt prints the code type 'SEARCH BOTWRECK'. The Peddler's drop is tagged 'PEDLAR STOCK'. netPingName falls back to the raw kind, so pings say SNITCH, CHOIR or STRAY (never-words for Crier, Pillbox and Survivor). Loot values use 'c' while every other money readout uses $. The ring badge says 'SOUND THE ALARM' (his words) while every prompt says 'CALL FOR EXTRACTION'.

problems.title: DOWNED and crew PICKED UP labels show through walls
problems.detail: The kill label is gated on canSee so that it cannot reveal positions (comment at 19231). '{NAME} DOWNED' (machines downing pillagers anywhere) and the crew 'PICKED UP' are not gated, and the fog only dims them.

problems.title: Player 2 never gets a kill number
problems.detail: On a linked window the hit is sent to the host and en.hp is not reduced locally, so dmgNum(...,en.hp<=0) is false on the killing round. netFxDmg forwards the same false flag, so neither window shows P2's 'N!' kill number.

problems.title: Units, numbers and casing differ across channels
problems.detail: Seconds: 's' in INBOUND, REVIVE, COOKING, CRIER; 'S' in LIGHTNING, the badge and EXTRACT IN PROGRESS. Precision: one decimal on COOKING and CRIER, whole numbers elsewhere. '+$1234' has no comma, while say() prints $1,234. Casing: CAPS prompts next to 'needs the Key', 'items left', '+N more out here', 'Dropped X' and Title Case loot names. Metres are 'M' on pings and 'm' in sentences.

problems.title: Nothing collides with nameplates or prompts
problems.detail: label() only avoids other labels. Kill, DOWNED, REVIVED, WEAK SPOT and +$ labels rise through the nameplate of the same body within about a second. Nameplates overlap each other in a crowd. Loot labels keep rising for 6 s (156 u), over walls and other plates.

problems.title: World text follows camera zoom; HUD prompts do not
problems.detail: Everything drawn on wc scales with ZOOM: user zoom 0.85-9 and the scope ADS zoom. Nameplates, labels and numbers shrink or balloon while the HUD prompts beside them hold their size. AAA games keep world text a fixed size on screen.

problems.title: Health pip width depends on the name
problems.detail: The overhead pip is plate width (tw+8), so 'FBI_Surveillance_Van' has a bar three times longer than 'Kite'. It is a flat 3 u strip, hostile red or gold, with no armour shown. World bars (wall damage, container progress) are also flat fillRects, while the HUD uses the v18.37 bar() capsule.

problems.title: Walls can paint over some world text
problems.detail: Cache tags, MERIDIAN STRONGBOX, the ammo tell, ALARM and the seal slab text are drawn inside the y-sorted pass, so a wall that sorts later covers them. Labels, numbers and nameplates are after the sorted pass and safe.

problems.title: Crier markers draw over the open backpack
problems.detail: drawCrierMarkers runs after drawBag, the drag ghost and trade, so its ring, chevron and CRIER text print across the backpack panel. Ring labels were already hidden under the backpack at v21.07.

problems.title: Ring badge has no letter
problems.detail: Every badge starts 'EXTRACTION POINT - ...', so two rings on screen read the same, while the compass, the messages and the other-ring prompt say 'Extract A'.

problems.title: Plates are measured on the untranslated string
problems.detail: fillText is wrapped to swap in TX() but measureText is not, so any line he rewrites with the in-game editor draws over a plate sized for the old words. No string in this slice is a TXSHIP key today, and TXPSHIP is empty.

problems.title: Assumption: 4K means W=3840 CSS px
problems.detail: All the 4K notes assume DPR 1, as the v19.x 4K screenshot fixes imply. With Windows scaling at 200%, hudRes() is 1 and none of the 4K branches run.

problems.title: One overwrite slot carries almost everything
problems.detail: About 242 say() sites write one G.msg line (3.2s). A new say() replaces the current line at once, so TEN SECONDS, a Crier alarm or a crash notice can be wiped by Took Scrap Metal in the same second. There is no priority, no category and no stacking.

problems.title: The queue is lower priority than the overwrite
problems.detail: sayWhenFree is a FIFO with no cap or dedupe that drains one line per 3.2s and only while the current line is idle. The most urgent co-op events (teammate down 38713, host gone 42458, teammate out 39697) go through it, so they wait behind trivia while any plain say() jumps ahead.

problems.title: No world prompt to revive a downed teammate
problems.detail: A downed AI pillager gets [E] REVIVE NAME 12s (27937). A downed co-op teammate gets only the queued message, the team row DOWN, the edge arrow and the map dot. REVIVING and Reviving NAME. Hold E. appear only after E is already held.

problems.title: Messages said under the open map are lost
problems.detail: The sector map paints opaque rgb(9,12,34) over the message line (drawHUD draws msg at 27812, the map at 29015). Waypoint marked, Waypoint cleared and Marker placed. Your party can see it. are always said while the map is open, so nobody ever sees them. Any other line also expires behind the map.

problems.title: Ten scaling regimes, so 4K mixes 1080p-size and 2x text
problems.detail: Text sizes go through FS, hudFS, hudZoomIn (HUDZ 1.05-1.5 x hudRes x userZ), hudAtIn, FSz, bFS, beltFS/beltCapFS, ad-hoc transforms, the world zoom (ZC x hudRes x ADS) and raw literals. At 4K the message, feed, banner and boss name double, but the gift line, use-bar text, pings, markers, edge-arrow labels, crier markers and map party names stay at 15.6-18.7px.

problems.title: Size count
problems.detail: Five TYPE roles (13.0/15.6/19.5/26/39 lifted; 15.6/18.7/23.4/31.2/46.8 at 1080p uiScale 1.2) times the panel multipliers give at least 18 distinct rendered sizes at 1080p, plus the belt sizes that follow the slot. 4K has about 25 sizes on screen at once, because some channels double and some do not. Weights are 600/700/800 plus raw 'bold'.

problems.title: About 12 plate treatments and no outline
problems.detail: Flat dark rects at alphas .55, .62, .72, .78, .86 and .90; hudPanel gradient+border at .62, .76, .78 and .84; a red notoriety plate rgba(24,6,4,.82) with a stroke; DOM .94 with a border. Much of the text has no plate at all: clock, compass, MARKED, extraction banner, prompts, pings, markers, crier, edge arrows, downed overlay. The canvas uses no shadowBlur or strokeText anywhere; the only shadows are INK 1px on damage numbers and #1B1622 2px on YOU DIED. World-label and nameplate plates are 13px tall under 15.6px text.

problems.title: No colour tokens on the canvas
problems.detail: CSS has --amber/--hazard/--coolant/--gain/--bone, but canvas text uses about 27 hex literals in the HUD and net draw code: six reds (#ff5a4a, #ff5040, #ff4a3a, #ff6b5a, #e2564a, #ff8a80), five near-whites and four greys. Only INK and SNDCOL are constants. Amber #ffc04a is used at once for prompts, warnings, your own feed kills, teammate nameplates, the waypoint, the boss name and the gift line.

problems.title: A teammate has no single identity colour
problems.detail: The teammate is amber in the world nameplate and the edge arrow, blue #bfe0ff in the rows, feed, map dots and markers, and cyan #6fe0ff on pings. The nameplate never changes when he is down.

problems.title: Units, casing and separators drift
problems.detail: Distances read 120m on the compass but 12M on pings, markers, edge arrows and the closest-extraction line. Seconds read 12s, 12S and 12S LEFT. Lines mix sentence case and CAPS (THIRTY SECONDS vs 2 minutes left.; YOU killed SENTRY). Separators are a double space, '  ·  ', ' - ' and ': '. The same prompt reads [E] CALL FOR EXTRACTION and HOLD E TO CALL FOR EXTRACTION. The same marker is called Waypoint and Marker; crier is written Crier, crier and CRIER.

problems.title: One event, several channels, different words
problems.detail: A gift offer shows a say() line and the gift line, worded differently. A revive shows a say(), the REVIVING bar and the REVIVED label on one side, and Revived by plus a label on the other. A teammate's extraction call shows a say() (Inbound in 30s.), the banner (INBOUND 30s) and the badge (30S UNTIL EXTRACTION BEGINS).

problems.title: Top-centre stack held together by globals
problems.detail: Clock, compass, MARKED, message, boss bar, gift line and controller-paused each work out their own y. They are chained through HUDBOSSB/HUDGIFTB set during the frame, with mixed scale spaces (some under the msg zoom, some in screen pixels). Draw order decides correctness, and the notoriety stamp (26% of H) and the centre verb are separate again.

problems.title: Message timer freezes
problems.detail: G.msgT and the queue only tick in the normal update branch. During the site burn (G.nuking), the death beat and a solo pause, the line stays at full strength and the queue never drains, so MERIDIAN IS BURNING THE SITE. sits until something overwrites it.

problems.title: Developer crash text in the player line
problems.detail: noteCrash says 'Something broke: <raw error>. It was written into your run report.' through say(), over whatever the player needed.

problems.title: Map party names are not map-scaled and skip the placer
problems.detail: netMapDots and netWpMapDraw use the global FS, not the map's local FSz(hudRes), so the names stay 1080p size at 4K. netMapDots is drawn via MAPLAST after mapPlaceLabels, so names can print over district labels.

problems.title: DOM overlays that can show in a raid
problems.detail: #topright (credits and XP, always on, its own CSS glow style). #hubtoast via say2 (storeWarn), which would sit at bottom 38px over the belt. #stalesave (z 99999). The pause box. The outcome card with the party block (inline 10.5-13px). The text editor input (monospace, dev only). None share the canvas styling.

problems.title: No voice-chat indicator
problems.detail: PTT and open mic exist (voiceGate) but nothing on screen shows who is talking or that your mic is live, and voice barks (voxGrunt/voxBreath) have no subtitles.

problems.title: World text follows the camera and ADS zoom
problems.detail: Labels, damage numbers and teammate nameplates are drawn on wc, so they change size with the mouse-wheel zoom and when aiming down sights (ZOOM = ZC x hudRes x adsZf).

problems.title: A second font family and raw sizes
problems.detail: partIcon and keyIcon draw REC, AMMO and SMK in 'bold Npx sans-serif', not Rubik. The heal ring (off by default) uses a raw '700 9px Rubik' that bypasses FS. drawLegend's MONO variable is Rubik micro, not a monospace face, and its compact rows step 16px for 15.6px text.

problems.title: TXSHIP keys in the raid
problems.detail: No live in-raid canvas HUD string is a TXSHIP key, so the raid feed can be reworded freely. The keys that touch a raid are the pause-box feedback line and the outcome-card lines: Run abandoned / +XP penalty / CLOSEST YOU CAME (blanked) / Copy report (blanked) / Next: reward (blanked). Number-bearing keys become shape patterns (TXPSHIP) that rewrite any string of the same shape. zoneBadge and extractNowLine are his words by comment, not keys.

problems.title: The plate is measured on the raw string, drawn translated
problems.detail: The fillText prototype wrapper applies TX() at draw time, but the message plate (27826) and the label plates (14223, 25966) measure the untranslated string. Any edited or TXSHIP line through these channels gets a wrong-width plate.

problems.title: Two windows: mostly correct, some gaps
problems.detail: say() is per window and private lines are gated by seat (netMarkTake mine, netContactTake, netKillTake). No private line was found showing on both windows. Shared lines are sent on purpose: door, boss, weather, hot ground, restock, extraction call, teammate down/out, host gone. Pad-facing gaps: the gift lines show 'T or Y' to both players, HOLD E TO CUT THE SEAL hard-codes E (28641), and the map header says CLICK / RIGHT-CLICK on the pad window.
